content: User is developing WuffAgent — a Rust agent system (Cargo workspace: wuffagent-core, wuffagent-egui, wuffagent-iced, wuffagent-iced-app). Worker agents are defined as JSON files in workers/. Requires Rust 1.75+.

User thinks philosophically about AI (embodiment, meaning, consciousness) but always wants practical, implementable answers. Prefers simple centralized designs over complex distributed ones when both work. Playful communication style.
